messages:
alex: quick ping — opened a tiny PR that fixes a formatting edge case in serving/kvcache. CI fmt check is red for one file. @maria can you eyeball? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2289
maria: on it, can you paste the failing output? I want to confirm it's just gofmt and not a codegen mismatch
ci-bot: golangci-lint: `gofmt` check failed in serving/kvcache/kvcache.go
ci-bot: ```
diff --git a/serving/kvcache/kvcache.go b/serving/kvcache/kvcache.go
@@
-    // CacheGet returns value or nil
-    func (c *Cache)Get(k string)(v Value,ok bool){
+    // CacheGet returns value or nil
+    func (c *Cache) Get(k string) (v Value, ok bool) {
```
jon: looks like a spacing/tab run-in — probably my editor plugin when I touched that comment last week
alex: yeah i accidentally saved with a weird tab in that func signature. `gofmt -w serving/kvcache/kvcache.go` should fix it; pushed a small fix to the branch just now
maria: thx — one tiny nit: imports are grouped slightly differently now, can you run `goimports` before pushing? keeps the import order consistent with the repo lint
alex: doing that, will force-push in a sec. also updated the comment to match styleguide
sam: quick ownership check — who's the reviewer for serving infra changes? if no objections i can merge during the next merge window after CI green. @jon are you ok with this small formatting change going in?
jon: fine by me, it's a mechanical change
maria: LGTM after goimports run :thumbsup:
ci-bot: triggered re-run: gofmt OK, unit tests started
ci-bot: build passed — all checks green
alex: thanks all — merging in next 15m slot. noted for post-merge: if anyone sees flaky kvcache behavior ping me
maria: nice one, thx for the quick turnaround :slightly_smiling_face:
sam: merged during slot — 🎉
__note: This thread captures a short PR/formatting coordination: root ping, failing gofmt output, quick fix, goimports suggestion, CI re-run, approvals and merge. Messages are in chronological order and use Slack-style brevity.
